correctness.rationale: On V=A/A², commuting idempotents decompose V=⊕V_epsilon. At each tensor degree d, the degree-d error f_i:V_s→(V^{⊗d})_t satisfies (s_i+t_i−1)f_i=0 from idempotence and (s_j−t_j)f_i=(s_i−t_i)f_j from commutation. Equal source/target weights force zero; unequal weights give a common coboundary h killed by a degree-d generator shear, preserving lower degrees, in every characteristic. Induction d=2,...,L proves simultaneous conjugacy. Automorphisms have |GL_n(q)| q^{n∑_{d=2}^L n^d} elements; the stabilizer is ∏_s |GL_{n_s}(q)| q^{∑_s n_s M_s}, yielding the exact asserted count and ranks ∑_{d=1}^L r_i^d. An independent enumeration of original F2 generator-image maps found 98 idempotents and 868 commuting pairs at (n,L,m)=(2,2,2), matching 4+(q+1)(5q^5+q^7).
